title: ITMAD CEO appointed to EIAC Advisory Technical Committee
summary: He serves on the committee in his personal capacity as the Representative of Accredited Inspection Bodies

contentHtml:
He serves on the committee in his personal capacity as the Representative of Accredited Inspection Bodies

Press Release

Abu Dhabi, UAE — Waqas Arshad, CEO of ITMAD Certification Services, took part in the meeting of the Emirates International Accreditation Centre (EIAC) Advisory Technical Committee held on 10 November 2026. He serves on the committee in his personal capacity as the Representative of Accredited Inspection Bodies.

The appointment reflects the growing role of accredited inspection and certification in the UAE, where industry, regulators and project owners increasingly rely on independent, accredited bodies to confirm that equipment, systems and organisations meet international standards.

EIAC has become one of the region's most forward-looking accreditation bodies. Through the dedication of its team, it has built strong partnerships with industry and continues to raise the standard of conformity assessment in the UAE.

"As the UAE's industrial base expands, the integrity of conformity assessment becomes national infrastructure," said Waqas Arshad. "I look forward to bringing the practical experience of accredited inspection bodies into EIAC's technical decisions."

About ITMAD

ITMAD Certification Services L.L.C is an EIAC-accredited inspection and certification body with offices in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, providing lifting equipment inspection, NDT and ISO management system certification. www.itmad.ae
